title: Demons
definition: Demons are fallen spiritual beings who oppose God and seek to deceive, torment, and enslave.
summary: Demons are fallen spiritual beings who oppose God and seek to deceive, torment, and enslave.
christFocus: Jesus commanded demons with authority and triumphed over every power through the cross.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Demons recognizes spiritual reality while keeping God, not the spiritual realm, at the center. Demons are real but never sovereign, and their power is subject to christ.

Scripture speaks soberly about angels, demons, Satan, and unseen conflict, but it refuses fear, obsession, and speculation. People can either deny demonic evil or fear it more than they trust jesus.

Christ is supreme over every spiritual being and power. Jesus commanded demons with authority and triumphed over every power through the cross. Believers stand in His victory through Scripture, prayer, faith, and the power of the Holy Spirit.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Spiritual reality affects real life, but Scripture keeps the believer from fear and fascination. People can either deny demonic evil or fear it more than they trust jesus. The unseen realm must be understood under the rule of God and the victory of Christ.

It also protects against spiritual confusion. Angels are servants, demons are defeated enemies, Satan is limited, and Christ alone is worthy of trust and worship.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Do not fear demons; stand in Christ’s authority and seek faithful help when oppressed. Bring this doctrine into prayer, Scripture, and daily obedience. Ask the Holy Spirit to make the truth real in your thinking, desires, relationships, and next faithful step with Christ.
